name: Bedlam 200SL Insecticide
lead: Bedlam 200SL is a soluble liquid (SL) insecticide for bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas in Kenyan homes. You mix it with water and spray it into the places pests hide, so one small bottle can treat a bedroom, a kitchen corner or the place a pet sleeps. It comes in 15 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml packs, so a tenant with one bed and a landlord with a whole block can each buy the size that fits the job.
features: Insecticide for bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas
Soluble liquid (SL) formulation that is mixed with water
Three pack sizes: 15 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml
Sprayed into mattress seams, bed frames, cracks and skirting boards
Delivered to all 47 counties
specs: Target pests: Bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas
Dilution: as printed on the manufacturer's label
helps: Bed bugs hide in mattress seams, bed frames, headboards and wall cracks, and bite at night. Cockroaches shelter in kitchens, drains and cupboards and spread germs over food and surfaces. Fleas live in bedding, carpets and the places pets rest. Because one bottle covers all three, Bedlam suits a household that finds more than one pest at the same time.
use: Mix Bedlam with water exactly as the label directs and spray with a hand-pump sprayer. Treat cracks, crevices, mattress seams, bed frames, skirting boards and other hiding places, and work through every affected room in the same session so pests cannot move next door. Keep people, pets and food away until the spray has dried, and repeat only if the label advises it. For fleas, treat pets with a vet-approved product at the same time.
before: Wash bedding and clothes at a high temperature and dry them well
Vacuum mattresses, carpets and corners, and empty the vacuum outside
Move beds and furniture away from the walls
Cover food, dishes, fish tanks and pet bowls
safety: Read the label before use. Wear gloves and a mask when mixing and spraying, and wash your hands afterwards. Keep it away from children, pets, food and water. Do not pour leftover mixture into drains, streams or ponds, and do not reuse the empty bottle.
storage: Keep in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place, away from food and children.
faq: Which Bedlam 200SL pack size should I buy?
The 15 ml pack suits one room or a single treatment. The 50 ml and 100 ml packs give you more product for several rooms or a rental you manage. Choose by the number of rooms you need to treat.
Does Bedlam 200SL work on fleas as well as bed bugs?
It is sold for bed bugs, cockroaches and fleas. Fleas also live on the animal, so treat pets with a vet-approved product and wash their bedding on the same day.
Will one treatment be enough?
Follow the label. Bed bugs hide well, so check mattress seams after a couple of weeks and repeat the treatment only if the label allows it and you still see bugs.

name: Bugnil 20EC Insecticide
lead: Bugnil 20EC is an emulsifiable concentrate (EC) insecticide for bed bug control in homes and rentals in Kenya. The 25 ml pack is sized for a single treatment, which makes it a practical buy for a bedroom, a bedsitter or a rental unit between tenants. You dilute it with water as the label directs and spray the places where bed bugs hide.
features: Insecticide for bed bug control
Small 25 ml pack for a single treatment
Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) mixed with water
For homes and rentals
Delivered to all 47 counties
specs: Dilution: as printed on the manufacturer's label
helps: Bed bugs are small, flat insects that spend the day in mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, wall cracks, loose wallpaper and furniture. At night they feed and leave itchy bites, small blood spots on sheets and dark droppings. They can go a long time without feeding and travel easily on luggage, clothes and second-hand furniture, which is why a problem in one room often reaches the next.
use: Strip the bed and wash bedding, curtains and clothes at a high temperature. Vacuum the mattress, frame, floor and corners and empty the vacuum outside. Dilute Bugnil exactly as the label directs, then spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks and other hiding places. Keep people, pets and food out of the room until it has dried, and repeat the treatment if the label advises it, because eggs and survivors can cause a return.
before: Move beds away from walls so you can reach the joints
Check second-hand furniture before bringing it indoors
Cover or remove food, dishes and pet bowls
Do not use bedding again until it is dry
safety: Read the label before use. Wear gloves and a mask when mixing and spraying, and wash your hands afterwards. Keep it away from children, pets, food and water. Do not spray bedding that will be used before it has dried. Do not pour leftover mixture into drains, streams or ponds, and do not reuse the empty bottle.
storage: Keep in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place.
faq: Is the 25 ml pack enough for a rental?
It is sized for a single treatment, such as one bedroom or bedsitter. For several units, hostels or repeated infestations, consider more than one pack or a licensed pest control operator.
Why do bed bugs come back after spraying?
Eggs and hidden survivors can remain in cracks, frames and furniture. Treat every affected room together, follow the label on repeat treatments and check second-hand items before they enter the home.
Can landlords use Bugnil between tenants?
Yes, it is intended for homes and rentals. Treating promptly between tenants stops a small problem becoming a bigger one, and a record of dates and rooms treated helps you follow up.

The 100 ml pack is diluted with water before spraying on cracks, bed frames and corners, and it gives enough product to handle several rooms, which is why it is popular with hostel managers, small hotels and landlords as well as households.

helps: Bedbugs hide in mattress seams, bed frames, headboards and wall cracks, and feed on people at night. Cockroaches live in kitchens, bathrooms, drains and behind cupboards. In hostels, hotels and rentals an infestation spreads quickly between rooms and affects guest and tenant satisfaction, so a quick, coordinated treatment matters more than treating one room at a time.
use: Dilute the concentrate with water as the label directs. Spray cracks, bed frames, mattress seams, skirting boards, door and window frames, corners and the other places where insects hide. Treat every affected room at the same time. Keep people, pets and food out of the room until the spray has dried, and repeat the treatment if the label advises it.
before: Strip beds and wash bedding, curtains and clothing at a high temperature
Vacuum mattresses, floors and corners, and empty the vacuum outside

safety: Keep away from children, food and pets. Read the label before use. Wear gloves and a mask when mixing and spraying, and wash your hands afterwards. Do not pour leftover mixture into drains, streams or ponds, and do not reuse the empty bottle.
storage: Keep in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place.
faq: Is Dudu-Stop suitable for hostels and hotels?
Yes, it is sold for homes, hostels and hotels. Treat all affected rooms together, keep a record of rooms and dates, and for large or repeated infestations consider a licensed operator.
What do I spray with Dudu-Stop?
Spray cracks, mattress seams, bed frames, skirting boards, door and window frames and corners, which are the places bedbugs and cockroaches use to hide, after diluting as the label directs.
How soon can people return to the room?
Keep people, pets and food out until the spray has dried completely, then ventilate the room. Follow any waiting time printed on the label.

It is an emulsifiable concentrate (EC) in a 100 ml pack that you dilute with water before spraying, so one purchase can cover the bedroom, the kitchen, the store and the staff area.
features: Public health insecticide concentrate
Controls bedbugs, cockroaches, houseflies, ants and fleas
Also works on other crawling insects
For homes, hotels and offices
Emulsifiable concentrate diluted with water
100 ml pack

Target pests: Bedbugs, cockroaches, houseflies, ants, fleas and crawling insects

helps: Bedbugs hide in mattress seams and bite at night. Cockroaches contaminate food in kitchens, drains and cupboards. Houseflies land on food and waste and spread germs. Ants follow food trails into kitchens and stores, and fleas live in bedding, carpets and pet areas. A single multi-pest concentrate is convenient where several of these problems appear in the same building.
use: Dilute with water before spraying, using the amount stated on the label. Apply to cracks, crevices, skirting boards, bed frames, the backs of appliances, door and window frames, bins and other places where insects hide or walk. storage: Keep in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place.
faq: Which pests does Lava 100EC control?
It is sold for bedbugs, cockroaches, houseflies, ants, fleas and other crawling insects in homes, hotels and offices. Pair it with good hygiene for longer-lasting results.
Can offices and hotels use Lava 100EC?
Yes. Plan the treatment so the whole building is sprayed within a short time, focus on kitchens, stores, bathrooms, bedrooms and drains, and keep a short record of dates and areas treated.
Is it ready to spray?
No, it is a concentrate. Dilute it with water in the amount stated on the label before spraying, and never mix it with other products unless the label allows it.

name: Promax 20 EC Odourless Bed Bug Insecticide
lead: Bed bugs, called kunguni in Swahili, hide in mattress seams, bed frames and skirting boards and bite while you sleep. Promax 20 EC is a propoxur-based, odourless insecticide concentrate that you dilute and spray straight into those hiding places. It also deals with cockroaches (mende), fleas, ants and houseflies, so one sachet protects a house, hostel room, hotel room or office.
features: Odourless formulation suited to bedrooms and other indoor spaces
Residual action on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across later are still affected
Multi-pest: bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies
Concentrated: 25 ml makes 1 litre of ready-to-spray liquid
Works with any hand-pump or knapsack sprayer
specs: Use: household and public-health crawling-insect control
Pack: 50 ml sachet, which makes 2 litres of spray
Mode of action: blocks nerve signal transmission, causing paralysis
helps: Bed bugs bite at night and hide by day in mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards and cracks. Cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies use the same cracks and corners to travel and breed. Promax stays active on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across them later are still affected, which helps in bedrooms, hostel rooms and offices where you cannot spray every day.
use: Half-fill the sprayer with clean water, add Promax, top up with water and shake well. Spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks, the backs of sockets and furniture joints. Wet the surfaces lightly and do not soak them. Bed bug eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if needed.
before: Strip the bed and wash bedding at a high temperature
Vacuum the mattress, frame and floor
Do not spray food, utensils or bedding you will use before it dries
safety: Keep children, pets and fish tanks out of the room until surfaces are dry and the room is ventilated. Wear gloves and wash your hands after use. Odourless does not mean harmless: it is still an insecticide, so keep it away from food, water and children.
storage: Keep the sachet or any leftover concentrate sealed in its original pack, in a cool, dry, locked place.
faq: How much spray does one 50 ml sachet make?
One 50 ml sachet makes 2 litres of ready-to-spray liquid, at 25 ml per litre. Always confirm the rate on the label of your pack before mixing.
Will I smell it after spraying?
The formulation is odourless, so it suits bedrooms. Let surfaces dry fully, ventilate the room and keep people and pets out until then.
Does one treatment remove bed bugs?
Eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if you still see bugs.
dose: 1 litre hand sprayer: 25 ml Promax 20 EC, topped up with water to 1 litre
5 litre garden sprayer: 125 ml, topped up to 5 litres
20 litre knapsack: 500 ml, topped up to 20 litres
Most homes need only 1 to 5 litres; the knapsack rate is for hotels, hostels and large premises
Always confirm the rate on your pack's label before mixing

lead: Familly Insect Killer is a super strength aerosol spray that kills flying and crawling insects, including cockroaches, mosquitoes and flies. It is ready to use straight from the can, so there is no mixing, measuring or sprayer to wash afterwards. It is sold as 1 can, which makes it an easy first buy for a flat, a bedroom or a kitchen.
features: Super strength aerosol spray
Kills flying and crawling insects
Works on cockroaches, mosquitoes and flies
Ready to use, with no mixing
Reaches corners, cracks and the areas around doors and windows
Sold as 1 can
specs: Product: Familly Insect Killer Super Strength Aerosol Spray
Target pests: Cockroaches, mosquitoes, flies and other flying and crawling insects
helps: Mosquitoes bite in the evening and at night and can carry disease. Flies land on food and rubbish and carry germs into kitchens and dining areas. Cockroaches hide in cracks, behind cupboards and under sinks and come out in the dark. An aerosol is convenient for quick treatment as soon as you see the pest, and for places where mixing a concentrate is not practical.
use: For flying insects, spray into the air in the room, then close the door and window for a while, as the label directs. For cockroaches, spray along skirting boards, behind appliances and in cracks, taking care not to spray food or cooking surfaces. Keep food and people away while spraying, and ventilate the room before going back in.
before: Cover or remove food, dishes, cooking utensils and baby items
Cover fish tanks and move pets and birds out of the room
Open windows and doors afterwards to let fresh air in
safety: Read the label before use. Do not spray towards people, pets or food. Do not spray near flames, cookers, heaters or sparks, because aerosol cans are flammable. Do not puncture or burn the can, even when empty, and do not leave it in direct sunlight or a hot car. Keep out of reach of children.
storage: Store upright in a cool, dry, well-ventilated place away from heat and children.
faq: Which insects does Familly Insect Killer work on?
It is sold for flying and crawling insects, including cockroaches, mosquitoes and flies, in the home.
Do I need to mix or dilute it?
No. It is a ready-to-use aerosol, so you simply spray from the can as the label directs.
How can I keep mosquitoes away for longer?
Use nets and window screens, clear stagnant water around the compound, take out rubbish daily and fix leaking taps so insects have fewer places to breed.

name: Kelvin Dudu Dust
lead: Safari ants marching into the house, fleas in the carpet or bed bugs in the frame are a daily headache you can fix with a pinch of powder. Kelvin Dudu Dust is a ready-to-use carbaryl insecticide dust: no mixing, no sprayer and no water needed. Sprinkle it into cracks, along ant trails and around nest areas, where wet sprays cannot reach.
features: Ready to use: open the pack and dust
Works in dry places where liquids cannot go, such as wall cracks, roof edges and nest boxes
Broad spectrum for household and farm pests: ants, fleas, bed bugs, lice, mites and ticks
100 g pack is small, affordable and easy to send countrywide
Handy for poultry houses, kennels and livestock sheds
helps: Dusts have a place that sprays do not. Ants nest in walls and under paving, fleas hide in floor edges and bedding areas, and poultry houses and kennels have perches, nest boxes and corners that a liquid would soak. Because the powder stays dry, it can be placed exactly where the pests travel and left to do its work.
use: The dust is applied dry, so there is no per-20 L rate. For ants, dust along trails, entry points and around the nest, and repeat when ants return. For fleas and bed bugs, dust floor edges, cracks, crevices, bed-frame joints, pet bedding areas and carpets, then brush or vacuum later as the pack directs. In poultry houses and kennels, dust litter edges, perches, nest boxes and corners. A thin, even film is enough, so do not heap it up.
before: Sweep or vacuum so the dust reaches the cracks and edges
Remove food, utensils and drinking water from the area
Wear a mask and gloves before opening the pack
safety: Read the label before use. Avoid breathing the dust, so wear a mask and gloves. Do not dust food, utensils or drinking water. Keep out of reach of children and pets, and wash your hands after use.
storage: Keep the pack tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from food, feed and children.
faq: What pests is Kelvin Dudu Dust for?
It is sold for ants, fleas, bed bugs, lice, mites and ticks around homes, poultry houses, kennels and livestock sheds.
Do I need water or a sprayer?
No. It is applied dry, straight from the pack, as a thin even film.
How often should I reapply it?
Reapply when the pests reappear, and remember that a thin film is enough, because heaps of powder do not work better.

name: Tatua Advion Cockroach Gel Bait
lead: Tatua Advion is a ready-to-use cockroach gel bait supplied in a 30 g applicator tube, with a four-tube pack of 4 x 30 g for larger premises. You place small dots of gel in the cracks, crevices and corners where cockroaches hide, in homes, restaurants, hotels and offices. There is nothing to mix, and the neat dots suit kitchens and food areas where sprays are awkward.
features: Ready-to-use cockroach gel bait
30 g applicator tube, or a pack of 4 x 30 g
Small dots placed in cracks, crevices and corners
For homes, restaurants, hotels and offices
No mixing needed
Delivered to all 47 counties
specs: Form: Ready-to-use gel in an applicator tube
Pack sizes: 30 g and 4 x 30 g
helps: Cockroaches hide in dark, tight places such as behind cookers, under sinks, inside cupboard hinges and around drains, and they contaminate food and surfaces. A gel bait works differently from a spray: cockroaches feed on the bait and return to their hiding places, which helps reach insects that never come out into the open. Because only small dots are used, it is neat and precise.
use: Clean the area first and remove food and crumbs so the bait is the most attractive food source. Apply small dots, not long lines, near hinges, behind appliances, under sinks, along cupboard edges and where you see droppings or cockroach activity. Do not spray insecticide on top of the bait, because it can put cockroaches off. Check after a few days and re-apply where the bait has been eaten or has dried out.
before: Empty and wipe the cupboards and counters where you will place gel
Fix leaks and seal cracks around pipes
Choose spots children and pets cannot reach
safety: Read the label before use. Keep away from children and pets, and apply only in places they cannot reach. Do not apply on food-contact surfaces, and wash your hands after use.
storage: Close the tube after use and keep it in a cool, dry place away from food, children and pets.
faq: Why use a gel bait instead of a spray?
Cockroaches eat the gel and go back to their hiding places, which helps reach hidden insects. The small dots also keep kitchens and food areas neat.
How much gel should I apply?
Use small dots, not long lines, in the places where cockroaches hide or travel, and re-apply where the bait has been eaten or has dried out.
Which pack should I choose?
The 30 g tube suits a home kitchen or a small shop. The 4 x 30 g pack suits restaurants, hotels and offices with many areas to treat.

It is sold in 20 g, 100 g and 400 g packs, so a household and a large farm can each choose a suitable size.

faq: Which Agita 1GB pack size should I buy?
The 20 g pack suits a small home or shop. The 100 g and 400 g packs suit larger kitchens, animal sheds and farms with several fly areas.
Where should I place fly bait?
Place it where flies gather, as the label directs, and keep it out of reach of children, pets and livestock and away from food.
How do I reduce flies for good?
Combine bait with cleanliness: cover bins, remove waste, keep drains and floors dry, and use screens on doors and windows.
